liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Wharf Rat** (2 reviews): The Wharf Rat that follows is called very tasty by the reviewer; Highlight of the show is The Other One going into Wharf Rat [11][12]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): This He's Gone was played as a memorial version for Abby Hoffman [11]
- **The Other One** (1 review): The Other One after the drums/space section is singled out as great [11]
- **Blow Away** (1 review): Blow Away is called one of the best versions, with an extended spoken rap from Brent [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1989-04-29.142344.schoeps.cmc4.mk2.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 25 songs; 177 min [1]
- **gd89-04-29.aud.wiley.9052.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 22 songs; 169 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience recording with excellent instrument separation and prominent bass, though the overall volume is quite low [13]
- **gd1989-04-29.fob.french.loy.76511.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 174 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1989-04-29.sbd.miller.88124.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [6]. Said about its sound: The Charlie Miller soundboard sounds better to this attendee than the show did in the room [14]
- **gd1989-04-29.164177.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 22 songs; 167 min [7]

## Around the show

- An attendee says this was the show that began their lifelong devotion to the band [16]
- The amphitheatre's incline puts that spot about ten feet above the soundboard; the OTS spot was far back, hard right [4]
- This was part of the last run the band ever played at Irvine Meadows [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1989-04-29.142344.schoeps.cmc4.mk2.mattes.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Ted Mattes; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Ted Mattes' Master Audience Dat; Schoeps CMC4/MK2 mics > Panasonic SV-250 (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Master Dat (Sony PCM R500) >… [1]
- **gd89-04-29.aud.wiley.9052.sbeok.shnf**: source: AUD>PCM>DAT>CDR [3]
- **gd1989-04-29.fob.french.loy.76511.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Mike French; source: Neumann km84i ortf-> Neu.p48v-> Sony TC-D5M -> Sony TC-D5M "B" n.r. on master. [4]. Also: Taped from first row center of section 6 loge, directly behind the soundboard, with mics clamped to the safety handrail above the lighting board [4]
- **gd1989-04-29.sbd.miller.88124.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90) [6]
- **gd1989-04-29.164177.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  December 23, 2022; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [7]. Also: Several UltraMatrix masters were combined to complete the show, converted from 2496 to 1644 [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1989-04-29 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1989-04-29-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [24]
